notes: IMOU (brand_id: imou) is Dahua Technology's consumer sub-brand (imoulife.com / imou.com). All IMOU IP cameras run Dahua firmware and use the Dahua /cam/realmonitor?channel=<N>&subtype=<typeNo> RTSP URL scheme. However, IMOU publishes NO official RTSP documentation: their support pages (imou.com/support, FAQs, product quick-start guides) contain no RTSP URL specification; their Open Platform developer API (open.imoulife.com) documents only HLS and RTMP live-stream endpoints. The path is universally confirmed by the community as inherited from Dahua firmware — see strix/verified/dahua.json (source: dahuawiki.com) for the verified Dahua template. Additional IMOU-specific access requirements: (1) RTSP must be enabled in the IMOU Life app (disabled by default on many models); (2) TLS/Encryption must be disabled in the app for plain-RTSP access; (3) authentication uses username 'admin' and the SAFETY CODE printed on the camera label (not the app password). Battery-powered Cell-series cameras have limited or no RTSP support (cloud-only). The leads with hardcoded base64 authbasic= values are per-device credential injections, not a URL schema feature.
